cohort: 143,889 neonates born at Northern California Kaiser Permanente hospitals between 2009 and 2013
finding: Both exclusive breastfeeding and newborn weight loss were associated with increased neonatal healthcare utilization, including higher readmission rates and more outpatient visits.
mod_finding: Exclusively breastfed newborns had higher readmission rates than those exclusively formula fed for both vaginal (4.3% compared to 2.1%) (P < .001) and cesarean deliveries (2.1% compared to 1.5%) (P = .025).
